comments.body: `DecodeAssigned` is false for some tables it quantifies over, so `bzip2/proofs/huffman` could not prove it. `decodeSym` (like `GET_MTF_VAL`, decompress.c:98-100) returns `dataError` when `zvec - base[zn] >= BZ_MAX_ALPHA_SIZE = 258`. But `Legal lens` and `Complete lens` do not bound `lens.length`. Counterexample, which I ran: `lens = List.replicate 512 9` is Legal and Complete (512 * 2^11 = 2^20), and `decodeSym lens (codeword lens 300) = .dataError`, not `.sym 300 []`. Symbol 100 does decode (`.sym 100 []`). Fix: add the alphabet bound the format imposes (`lens.length ≤ 258`, `BZ_MAX_ALPHA_SIZE`) as a hypothesis, e.g. `Legal lens → lens.length ≤ 258 → Complete lens → ...`, or fold it into `Legal`/a separate named predicate, and say so in the module doc. An `example` for the 512-symbol table would also document the case.

last.summary: Checked: `verify.sh` passes (all stages ok, `verify: ok`) and `check-task.sh spec/huffman` prints `check-task: spec/huffman: ok`; only `projects/bzip2/spec/Bzip2/Spec/Huffman.lean` is changed relative to the merge-base. I read the cited C lines (decompress.c:43-65, 74-102, 282-284, 323-344; huffman.c:152-200; compress.c:73-77, 562-566, 583-587; bzlib_private.h:115) and they support the claims. I re-derived against the C: `code`/`startAt` vs `BZ2_hbAssignCodes` (vec doubling between lengths); `limit`/`vecAt` vs `BZ2_hbCreateDecodeTables` (limit is 0 outside minLen..maxLen); `base` (count of lengths < n, then the fix-up `2*(limit[n-1]+1) - base[n]` using the pre-fix-up base); the `zn > 20` check at the top of the loop, so `dataError` only after the 21st bit and `needMoreInput` if the input ends at 20 bits; the index claim for `zn > maxLen` (base = alphaSize, zvec = 0 gives negative index) and that this is unreachable because zvec only grows and `limit[minLen] >= 0`; MSB-first bit order (decompress.c:48-49); and that `bsW` does not mask `v` so over-subscribed codes spill into earlier bits (compress.c:75). All match. One defect: `DecodeAssigned`, the statement left for `bzip2/proofs/huffman`, is false as stated (see the comment on line 166). It needs a `lens.length ≤ 258` hypothesis; the task says to prove or state the property, and a false statement cannot be proved. Not blocking: the doc says `Int32` for the table values citing decompress.c:130-137, which declares only the locals (zn, zvec, zj, gMinlen); the limit/base arrays are declared elsewhere. Say so if you touch the doc.
